datasets.name: DocLayNet
datasets.modality: page images plus COCO layout annotations

download.reason: full image corpus is large; enable manually if layout-image benchmarking is needed

datasets.notes: Human-annotated, diverse document pages; native eval uses local PDFs, COCO JSON layout annotations, image metadata, or supported documents when available.

datasets.name: PubLayNet
datasets.modality: page images plus COCO layout annotations

download.reason: full dataset is hundreds of thousands of page images

datasets.notes: Large PMC-derived scientific layout benchmark; local COCO JSON annotations are supported when installed.

datasets.name: DocBank
datasets.notes: Repository clone gives tooling/index/sample material without mirroring the full corpus; native token-label text annotations extract words, labels, and boxes when PDFs are absent.

datasets.name: PubTabNet
datasets.modality: table images plus HTML-like structure targets

download.reason: full table-image corpus is large and not native-PDF aligned

datasets.notes: Native JSONL table structure annotations extract HTML-style rows, cells, and non-empty cell boxes when installed locally.

datasets.name: PubTables-1M
datasets.modality: PDF pages, images, and table structure annotations

download.reason: requires generated Microsoft Research Open Data Azure URL

datasets.notes: Supports GriTS-style scoring when official data is installed locally; native XML, grid-cell JSON, and word-box JSON extraction read table boxes and text.

datasets.name: TableBank
datasets.notes: Repository clone gives sampled table images; native image-page blocks preserve full-image geometry and anchors when PDFs are absent.

datasets.name: FUNSD
datasets.notes: Small OCR/form benchmark; native JSON form annotations, Tesseract TSV, ALTO XML, PAGE XML, and hOCR HTML extract OCR text and boxes, with image metadata as fallback.

datasets.name: SROIE
datasets.notes: Scanned receipt benchmark; native CSV OCR boxes, Tesseract TSV, ALTO XML, PAGE XML, and hOCR HTML extract receipt text and geometry, with image metadata as fallback.

datasets.name: RVL-CDIP

download.reason: large image classification corpus; routing benchmark, not structure extraction

datasets.notes: Useful for future routing/classification; native image-page blocks preserve TIFF geometry and anchors when installed locally.

datasets.name: READoc
datasets.notes: MIT-licensed benchmark; default download is bounded to released Markdown ground-truth files, while native Markdown extraction preserves headings, tables, lists, and paragraphs.

datasets.name: OmniDocBench
datasets.notes: Moderate-size modern parsing benchmark; native JSON annotations extract page text, tables, formulas, and boxes when PDFs are absent.

datasets.name: olmOCR-Bench
datasets.notes: Strong deterministic CI fit; this runner first measures native parse coverage on local PDFs.

datasets.name: ckorzen benchmark
datasets.modality: scientific PDFs plus text extraction targets
datasets.notes: Good native text, order, paragraph, and role benchmark; bundled text/HTML and feature-box TSV resources now exercise non-PDF fallback extraction.

datasets.name: S2ORC

download.reason: very large corpus and not a direct PDF geometry benchmark

datasets.notes: Useful as text/reference comparison data; JSON/JSONL and gzipped JSONL corpora are supported when installed locally.

datasets.name: PMC OA

download.reason: article-level licenses vary; mirror subsets deliberately

datasets.notes: Licence varies by article, so automatic bulk download is disabled; local XML/JATS files and zip/tar source packages are supported.

download.reason: bulk source/PDF alignment requires careful licence and source mapping
